entries.3de7849a0a78764b: The company motto is “Let us create a company that contributes to the happiness of the people involved,” and its management philosophy is “Let us become an indispensable infrastructure for local cities, mountainous areas and remote islands.” Its key measures are strengthening sales capability through closer cooperation with agricultural cooperatives; developing professional personnel and expanding services by cultivating qualified staff such as DIY Advisors and Green Advisors; restructuring its profit structure through reorganizing logistics centered on a new distribution center and raising the share of private brand products; and promoting operational reform through reviewing store operations and using AI. Its priority issues are increasing sales through enhanced services such as repair, rental and technical support, and improving productivity through store efficiency and rebuilt logistics.
